Excellent work, my child. I'm pleased to confirm that after some initial... disagreements, we have managed to agree to arrangements that I think will suit all parties nicely.
You? We know you... You have fought in the Theatre before...
That's right. I guess I won't be doing that again now.
You think the Theatre will close? No... My pretties must feed. The Theatre will provide for them...
You're not planning on letting her keep preying on the weak are you?
Not at all, my child. Instead, I have promised her a far better feast.
Yes... No more will we dine on scraps...

We have made a deal. Once Drakan is dealt with, I will allow the Theatre to remain open. However, rather than false promises of freedom, the Theatre will be a place where the strongest may choose to test themselves.
Yes... We will continue to feed, but only on those who wish to enter, and only if they fail to survive...
Father Sugadinti, forgive me for my intrusion, but there is news of Vanescula's location.
Go ahead, my child.
Father Sugadinti, we believe we have located Vanescula Drakan, but we humbly request that you send assistance.
If you head east of Burgh de Rott and then north, you will find a ruined building. We will be waiting there.
I'd better get over there.
Go quick, my child. I wish you good luck.
. You made it.
Did everything go okay at the Theatre?
I think so. The Nylocas Queen has agreed to help us.

Another monster as an ally. Still, maybe here we can at least finally get rid of one of those monsters. One of the villagers from Burgh de Rott says they saw a vampyre entering this ruin with a very tall man.
That has to be them. Let's not waste any time.
Agreed., you and I will head inside and deal with Vanescula while Ivan keeps watch out here with the aranei.
You two be careful in there.
Don't worry, we will.
After you,.
Vanescula!
Ah, it's you two. I was hoping to spare you this...
Spare us what? Your betrayal?
Spare you the truth! I knew you'd never be able to handle it.
Well, you're god damn right there. Whatever it is you think the truth is, we don't accept it. Now give us Safalaan!
I can't do that, and besides, you're already too late.
This is another vampyrification lab... What have you done?
Only what needed to be done! You've seen what my brother can do. You can't stop him, not even with your new friend, Sugadinti!
But Safalaan... Icyene blood runs through his veins... He has the potential to be unstoppable!

But you can't accept that! You can't accept that this is the only way to defeat my brother! That is why you will always fail. You think that hope alone will win you this war? Sacrifice! That's what wins wars!
Veliaf!
Safalaan wait!
Safalaan... Safalaan is gone!
That's not true. He's right here in front of me. Let me help you, Safalaan. It's not too late. We can reverse this!
No... Leave me!
We're in this together, Safalaan. I'm not about to abandon you now.
Then stay... Stay and die!
Is everything okay in there, ?
Not exactly... I need to get back in there quick.
Should I come with you?
No, you stay out here. Last thing we need is more vampyres coming in.
Okay, but please be careful,.
Argh!
Safalaan?
... Please... I can't control it! You have to go!
You need to fight it, Safalaan!
No!
! Are you okay?!
Ivan... Is Veliaf okay...?
He's hurt badly, but he's alive.
What about Vanescula?
Alive as well, but in an even worse state. The aranei took her, but... what happened here? There was some sort of... creature!
Safalaan...
No! It can't be!
We need to get after him!
No... Get Veliaf to safety. I'll go after Safalaan.
Are you sure? You've been pretty badly beat up yourself.
I'll be fine. Just tell me which way he went.
North, past those old barrows.
Ivan... we can still stop this. Once Veliaf is safe, I need you to make a Guthix balance potion. We need to get it to Safalaan before he fully transforms.
Okay. Be careful,.
He's going for the castle... This isn't good. I need to find the others!
, I was just about to come and find you! What happened? Did you find Safalaan?
Sort of... I was able to follow his trail for a while, but I wasn't able to go any further. That said, I'm pretty sure he was heading for Castle Drakan.
Castle Drakan? You don't think...?
He's going for Drakan.
Then that is where we must go as well, my child, for the time has come. The blood moon has fully risen, and my disciples tell me the vampyres are gathering outside the castle.
Well, best we get a move on then.
Have you seen yourself, Veliaf? You're in no state to be going anywhere.
Your friend is right, my child. You should remain here.
You must be joking!
Veliaf...
What about Safalaan?!
We'll bring him back safe.
Just make sure you put Drakan in the ground for me.
You know you don't have to come with us either, Ivan.
I know... but I will.

That day... in that courtyard... we lost. And we could have just turned and run. Truth be told, we nearly did. But that wasn't our first loss, nor our second... We've lost so many times, we've lost count!
But it doesn't matter. It doesn't matter how many times we fail. It doesn't matter how many of us fall. To be honest, it doesn't even matter if we all fall!
Because no matter what, someone will always choose to keep fighting. Because the thing that we fight for will never die.
You've got a knack for giving a good speech, Ivan. Must have learnt from the best.
Yeah, and Safalaan were pretty good teachers.
Hmph. Go on, get going. Don't want to keep Drakan waiting.
Yes... Make sure you are well prepared, my child, then let me know when you are ready to depart.
Is it... true?
True?
Some of the others... They said someone was using the pub again. Does that mean the Myreque are back?
It can't be true! Look, they have a vampyre with them! It's all a trick! Now we're all doomed!
Wait! It's okay! He's with us. He's going to help us deal with Drakan, once and for all!
Once and for all? You really mean that?
We do. Drakan's tyranny finally ends today.
Then it is true... The Myreque are back!
Well...
Yes, the Myreque are back.
I never thought I'd see this day come!
The Myreque are back!
The Myreque are back.
Good luck, my friends. Know that all of Morytania is behind you.
Myreque prevail!
Myreque prevail.
Well, no point wasting time I suppose. Let's finish this,.
Go on, get going, before I go changing my mind about all this.
And so the time has finally arrived. I see some of you have come prepared. I trust you understand that your ability to round up starving humans will not be enough for you to survive this night.
I also see that some have decided to remain absent. It's surprising... Lord Jovkai was so eager to speak up before, yet now he is nowhere in sight.
Or perhaps he just has no interest in watching this farce!
Lord Myrmel, I must confess that you've impressed me. I was sure you would join Lord Jovkai in finding a hole to hide in.
Unfortunately, that alone won't be enough to keep you alive. I suspect even the human-borns would have no trouble in dealing with you. However, I do not intend to give them the chance.

It was originally my hope that my dear sister Vanescula would be the first to offer her blood, but circumstances have changed somewhat since then. No matter though, for I am more than capable of adapting.
The portal to our salvation. This is our destiny. Now, it needs power, and Lord Myrmel was merely the first to provide it, for at long last, the Night of the Blood Moon is here.
Lord Drakan. I hope we are not late.
Sugadinti... Until a short while ago, I could never have even imagined you being present on this night. However, I must admit, it feels fitting...
You... Efaritay... Even the humans... You all represent my greatest failings, but now you will help me put those failings right.
I'm afraid that we have decided on... alternate arrangements for the future of the vampyres. Unfortunately, my daughter is not here to help you this time.
No matter, Sugadinti. I do not require her to be able to kill you.
You may well be correct, but it is not me alone that you face.
I see you've been busy...
The question is, will it be enough?
I suppose we're about to find out...
What are you doing? Safalaan's still through there!
Safalaan? Are you saying that thing...
Sugadinti! We need to reopen the portal!
I'm sorry, Efaritay, but we can't risk it. Drakan is now trapped. We can't let him back through!
I will not abandon my son!
Your son sacrificed himself to save us all! We can't undo that!
Sacrificed?! You have no idea if that's the case!
Efaritay, we can't-
What if you're wrong about this? If so, Drakan will just use my son's blood to come back anyway!
Your son has been turned! His blood has been tainted! Drakan won't be able to use it for anything. It's over, Efaritay! We've won!
Won? You would celebrate this as a victory? Is that all this was about to you? I trusted you to be better than Drakan!
Well, fine! Celebrate if you wish, but I will not leave my son behind!
Efaritay's right! We need to go and help Safalaan!
I promise you, we will discuss this matter properly, but first, the crowd needs to be placated. I must address them. Please, wait for me inside the castle...
So... It is done...
It seems so. I trust you'll remember your side of the deal?
Sugadinti... We do not like him. He has methods to hurt us... We should rule, not him! But we agreed... As long as we can feast, we are satisfied...
I suppose that's the best we can hope for.
Yes... You should come to the Theatre again soon... You will be a fine meal...
My condolences for the loss of your friend. He will be remembered.
What are we going to do?
I don't know...
Safalaan needs our help! We have to find Efaritay!
Agreed, but first, we'd best wait for Sugadinti and see what he has to say.
Hmm... Okay.

My children, I'm sorry for rushing you inside. Time was of the essence in gaining control of the vampyres. However, I have promising news. It seems that for now at least, most are willing to accept me as their ruler.
I couldn't care less who they accept as their ruler. I want to know what happened here! Where is Safalaan?!
I'm afraid, my child, that your friend is gone. He sacrificed himself so that we could defeat Drakan.
Gone?! No! I don't believe that!
I'm sorry my child. You have my deepest sympathies, but his sacrifice will not be in vain. With Drakan gone, that which you have fought so hard for can finally come to be.
There is much that will need doing, and it will take many years, but peace will finally be a possibility for these lands.
And Safalaan is the cost?! What about her over there? You mean to tell me she gets to live and he doesn't?!
I believe there is benefit in keeping Vanescula alive, my child. She knows the vampyres here in a way I don't. She will be of great help in keeping them in line.
However, I assure you, she will live as a prisoner forever more. Her days of scheming are at an end.
You expect us to accept these half measures? Let me put a blade through her. That will be the only way to stop her scheming.
We will all need to accept compromise here, my child.
But what if you're wrong about all of this? What if Safalaan is still alive? And what if Drakan is somehow able to find a way to still use his blood?
And let's not forget Efaritay. Even if you think Safalaan is gone, she doesn't.
And that is why I have a request for you, my child. However, Ivan, Veliaf, I must first ask something of the two of you as well.
My disciples tell me that you have connections with the human lands to the west. I must ask you to travel there at once.
They will quickly learn of what happened here. They must be reassured that we are no danger to them.
We're not going anywhere until we know what's happening with Efaritay and Safalaan!
There is no time, my children. Things remain highly delicate here. It is my understanding that the human lands have no interest in war. They must be made aware that we feel the same way.
Besides, Veliaf is still too injured to handle the Efaritay situation, but I promise you, here will deal with it. You have my word.
I'm warning you, Sugadinti... if you do anything to prevent Safalaan from making it home, you won't even live long enough to regret it.
Come on, Ivan. Let's get going.
Good luck,. Please... bring Safalaan back.
So, I take it you want me to find Efaritay?
Yes, my child. I fear that in her current state, she will do something regrettable.
You mean go to Vampyrium?
If she does so, she risks giving Drakan a route back here. We cannot take that risk.
And Safalaan?
You must understand me, my child. I would very much wish to be proven wrong about his death, but if your friend is alive, saving him cannot be at the risk of undoing our victory here.
Hmm... I have a feeling I know where Efaritay will have gone. I'll go there at once.
Thank you, and good luck, my child.
Remember what I told you back in Vampyrium, ? It seems I am to once again be made a stranger in my own home.
It's a better fate than you deserve.
I did what I had to, just as I will continue to do so. If Sugadinti is to be our new leader, then so be it.
But make no mistake, if even for a second I come to feel that we'd be better off without him, well... he should probably make sure it isn't me washing his cup.
No, I think your days of washing cups are done. Farewell, Vanescula.
... I take it Sugadinti sent you?
He did.
He's wrong about Safalaan. I know my son is alive and I'm going to go and save him. Sugadinti can't stop me, and neither can you.
Sugadinti's not wrong to be concerned. Whatever happens next, we can't risk undoing our victory against Drakan.
But that's why I'm not here to stop you. I'm here to help you. If you're going to Vampyrium, then so am I.
You... Are you sure?
I am.
Thank you...
Well, no point wasting any time, I suppose. Safalaan's waiting for us.
Safalaan!
... Is that you?
It's me, Safalaan, but I'm not alone. Efaritay is here. You're safe now.
Mother... It's really you?
I'm here, my son. I'm here.
The transformation is almost complete, but there's still time. You need to get him out of here, quick!
Drakan...
Get him back to the portal and get back to Morytania.
No. I know you didn't just come here for Safalaan, Efaritay, but he needs you. All of Morytania needs you.
We don't have time for this!
Which is why you need to go now.
Mother...
I promise you, this ends here. Now go. Get Safalaan to safety.
Thank you.
Is Safalaan okay?
I'm not sure yet. He's very weak. But... why are you back here? Is it done?
Not yet, but it will be, I promise.
This land... There's such beauty here, but none of them ever stopped to truly see it...
You know, since the day I claimed my father's title, I've found myself wondering when I will meet the same fate...
I've seen empires rise, then watched them crumble into dust... I've witnessed the ascension of gods, then watched those same gods fade into nothing...
And through all those years, I've stared death in the face more times than I can count, only to defy her each and every time.
But now, here you stand. You understand that even with me in this state, the odds are very much against you. Yet despite that, you stand here all the same.
You. A mere human... I don't even know your name.
But even if you succeed here... Even if it is you who will rise and I who will fall... it does not matter, for I am right where I need to be...
Home.
It's done. Safalaan?
I'm sorry... His wound... It's too great. If we reverse the vampyrification...
No! What can we do? There must be something we can do!
We either let his finish transforming, or he dies...
No!
No...
Mother......
Please... Kill me!
Never. You are my son. I will never abandon you.
I can feel it... The urge... I must... feed!
I will help you control it. There are potions that can be made. Rituals that can help. No matter what, we will overcome this, together.
You... You promise?
I do. I'm here, my son. I will never leave you again.
Mother... thank you...
... You never gave up on me.
And I never will, Safalaan. Like it or not, you and I are in this together.
I should get him to Darkmeyer. I'll be able to help him properly there.
You should have this before you go.
Keep it. My days of fighting are over. It's yours now.
Are you sure?
Surer than I've been for a long time. Now we'd best get going. Are you coming with us, ?
You go on ahead. I'll join you later.
Very well... Thank you,. For what you've done for me... but more importantly, for what you've done for Safalaan.
Yes, citizen. Do you need something?
How are things with Morytania?
Couldn't be better! After all that fearmongering from you, citizen, it turned out they actually wanted to be friends! Good job you're not the King.
I don't think that's quite...
Yes, I agree! It's very good indeed.
I do still feel that we should reconsider this new alliance, my lord. Vampyres are beasts of Zamorak!
Well, you were very worried about those Guthixian edicts, Aeonisig. Surely with this new alliance, we've managed to achieve the perfect balance those Guthixians always wanted!
Yes, but the Church of Saradomin...

Oh, don't worry yourself, Aeonisig. It's not like we'll be inviting any of them over any time soon. No, this new arrangement is perfect. We can be all be friends, but just from a safe and healthy distance!
Anyway, what was it you wanted, citizen?
You know, I think I'll actually be on my way...
Vanescula. You're still in your vampyre form?

Yes, nice of you to point that out. Thanks to my injuries, shapeshifting is no longer possible for me. I'm likely stuck in this disgusting form forever now. Lowerniel would probably have been thrilled.
We humans have a saying, Vanescula: If you play with fire, you're going to get burnt.
I burnt myself for a better future, for my people, and for yours.
After all that's happened, do you really still believe that?
You may not like what I did, but whether you accept it or not, Lowerniel was only defeated thanks to me.
I was the one that turned Safalaan, giving him the strength to injure him. I was the one that gave you the information needed to make a weapon capable of killing him.
We'd have found another way.
You're free to keep telling yourself that, but deep down, I think you know the truth. Now, while this has been a thrilling chat, I've tired of conversing with you. Be on your way.
Hello there,. It's good to see you.
I could use a new weapon.
Of course.
How are you feeling about being back here?
It is still strange. I no longer recognise any part of these lands.
Do you think they can ever go back to how you remembered them?
No. Sugadinti suggested that we rename Morytania back to Hallowvale, but I declined. Hallowvale will never exist again. It is nothing more than a memory now.
However, that doesn't mean we can't still create something new here. Morytania does not need to be the dark land it currently is. With time, a lot is still possible.
I'm glad Sugadinti has you to support him. Do you think you'll ever properly rule alongside him?
My days of leading ended long ago. However, I will always be here to help where needed.
That's good to hear.
How is Safalaan doing?
As well as can be expected. You saw for yourself the horrifying effects the vampyrification process had on him.
Vanescula said it was because of his icyene blood?

Indeed. Drakan called them wyrds. Far more powerful than a normal vampyre, but far more prone to uncontrollable hunger as well. He showed me one once. A little gloat about what he could do to my people.
But you've been able to keep that hunger in check?
As best as we can. He must feed. That is not something that can be avoided, but I have been making him potions to help him stay in control.
With time, I hope I can refine things further. We may even find a way for him to utilise the shapeshifting abilities possessed by other vampyres.
Well, if there's anything I can do to help with that, just let me know.
Thank you, but I think I have all that I need. It's just time and patience now. That said, while I do not need anything myself, I'm sure Safalaan would be keen to see you.

No doubt you've seen that Sugadinti has opened a new portal to Vampyrium. Safalaan has been spending a lot of his time there, helping the aranei with their work. I think he prefers to be away from this place.
Understandable. I'll make sure to check in and see how he's getting on.
Take care out there.
Welcome back, my child.
How are things in Morytania?
Very good, my child. My disciples are providing a steady supply of their blood for the vampyres. As promised, the tithing of humans has been completely outlawed.
And the vampyres are all happy with that?
Most are understanding of the fact that regardless of anything else, the days of tithing humans were running short. However, it is true that some found human blood to be more... appetising.
I assume that won't be a problem?
You need not fear, my child. Any that attempt to take blood from a human will be dealt with harshly.

That said, my understanding is that some humans did willingly provide their blood to the Drakans. It is of course possible that could be explored again in future, albeit with very different arrangements.
However, I very much understand that will likely be a... difficult proposal for most to swallow.
Yes, I can't see many being up for that sort of thing. Speaking of which, how are the humans of Morytania doing?
The fact that they are not being tithed is on its own a significant improvement to their quality of life. However, their homes are still ruins and these lands are still dangerous.
We are offering our help in building them new homes, but it will take many years, and most are still naturally distrusting of our kind.
I'm guessing a lot will be more interested in starting new lives across the Salve.

You are correct, my child. However, while we have established somewhat of an... understanding with your human kingdoms to the west, it is their preference that we try to limit how many humans relocate over there.

They are not equipped to deal with a large number of refugees, and it is also our hope that many humans will realise they still have a place here. We will need their help restoring these lands to glory.
That's not going to be an easy undertaking.
It will most certainly take many of your human lifetimes, but I have no doubt we will make it so.
I see you've opened a new portal to Vampyrium.
Yes... While my disciples are currently providing blood for the vampyres here, I do not consider that a suitable long-term solution. Haemalchemy, I believe, will be the true answer.

With us having outlawed the practice of vampyrification, we have started using the labs to explore the creation of artificial blood instead. Curiously, we've already had some luck with daeyalt of all things.
It seems that the very substance that is the key to making vampyres can also potentially contribute to feeding them. While it makes sense in many ways, it was also rather... unexpected.
Interesting... And how does Vampyrium play into this?

Vampyrium is home to all manner of flora and fauna that cannot be found here. With the threat of Drakan dealt with, my disciples can freely travel to and from there, collecting samples to use in our experiments.

You are more than welcome to use the portal yourself, my child. Blood donations from Efaritay and my disciples keep it well powered, and it may be that you'll find Vampyrium to offer something of interest to you.
I'd best be off.
Until next time, my child.
Safalaan.
It's strange, this place. From the plants, to the creatures... even the land itself. It's all undeniably horrifying, and yet... there's a certain feeling of peace here.
I wonder if it's the simplicity. There are no politics here. No debates. You don't need to care about good or evil, because there isn't any. Here you can just... be.
Or of course, maybe that's just the monster within me talking.
You're no monster, Safalaan.
Are you sure? How do you know I'm not about to try and eat you right now?
Er... You are joking right?
Probably... Or am I? Hard to say for sure... You never know when the urge to feed will take hold...
Come on, look at me. Even other vampyres consider me an abomination... At least let me find some humour in all of this.
*hmph* Like you'd be able to eat me anyway. You do remember that I'm the one that finally killed Drakan, right?
In truth, I can still barely believe it. All those years fighting him, and now it's finally all over... It almost doesn't feel real.
Well, you were a bit out of it for a fair chunk.
Oh, so the humour is only okay when you do it?
Just seems a bit unfair to kick me while I'm down... Maybe I should eat you...
It's good to see you haven't changed, Safalaan.
And for as long as I have friends like you, I hope I never will. Thank you... truly.
Like I told you, Safalaan, we're in this together. Anyway, I'll leave you to it, but we'll talk more soon.
Until next time,.
Well met,. Fancy a drink?
Do I get a friends discount?
See how the walls are still falling down?
Yeah?
Good. Then you see why there are no discounts here. Now, want that drink?
How are things going, Veliaf?
Not too bad. Business isn't the fastest here unsurprisingly, but I still get plenty of people stopping off on route from Paterdomus to the Theatre of Blood.
Some have suggested we don't stock a wide enough range of drinks, but others seem quite appreciative of the lack of nonsense on the menu.
Well, I'm glad the pub is doing well, but I was actually asking about you.
Me? Oh, I'm fine. The war is over and we mostly won. I'm finally getting to enjoy some peace and quiet.
So you're... happy?
Happy? I wouldn't go that far. I'd be happier if the vampyres were gone completely and Safalaan wasn't now one himself, but given all that happened, I'll take what I can get.
Have you visited him?
Safalaan? No. He's come here a few times, but I've made it clear I won't be setting foot in Darkmeyer ever again. The vampyres may still be around, but my days of breaking bread with them are done.
Anyway, enough about all that. How about a drink?
Seen much of Ivan recently?
Yeah, he comes to visit a fair bit. Sometimes without Drezel's permission, I suspect...
And everything's good between the two of you?
We've... talked, if that's what you're getting at?
What about?
The importance of a good drink. So, fancy giving the questioning a rest and buying one?
Fair enough.
. How are things?
Not too bad, Drezel. How about here?
Well, it's nice to not have to worry as much about the vampyres, but I must admit, I'm still not overly comfortable about the fact that we're now all trying to be friends.
It was that or we try to kill them all, and I'm not totally sure wiping out a whole race would have been the best of ideas either... not that we'd have ever likely been able to.
You make a good point. And I suppose the King is behind it, even if that advisor of his isn't... Even still, I'm glad we have the Salve to stop them if they do try anything.
In happier news, Ivan is now able to properly focus on his studying... though he does still sneak off for the odd adventure from time to time.
Well, I suppose you can't be too picky.
Indeed. The important part is that he will be a worthy successor. Of that, I can be confident.
I couldn't agree more. Until next time, Drezel.
It's good to see you, Ivan.
How are things going?

Pretty good, though Drezel seems to think that just because the vampyres aren't trying to kill us now, he can work me twice as hard! I know he just wants the best for me, but it's a bit overwhelming at times.
Someone really should break it to him that while he is getting on a bit, he's not that old! He's got quite a few years left of looking after this place before worrying about me taking over.
Still, at least he's not moaned too much about me taking the odd trip into Morytania. He's also allowed me to start looking into an old columbarium that might be buried somewhere under the temple.
Columbarium?
Yes! It's an old burial chamber that one of the books in the library mentioned. I'm trying to work out where abouts it is so we can see if anything is left of it.
Interesting... You said you'd taken a trip or two into Morytania as well?
That's right. I went down to Burgh de Rott to visit Veliaf in his new pub. It's still a bit of a mess down there, but he's slowly working on it. The alcohol isn't terrible either.
I've visited Safalaan a few times as well. He always seems pretty upbeat, but I do worry about him... Having to live as a vampyre... It must be horrible!
At least he has Efaritay now.
That's true. She seems to be doing well as well, though it can't be easy for her to be back in her old homeland.
True, but I can't think of anyone better to help bring back a little bit of the old Hallowvale.
That's a shame. I'll miss the swamps.
What? Not a fan of the ghasts?
*sigh* I'll see you later, Ivan.
Until next time,.
Until next time.
See you later,.
